label: linux-arm64-py314-plugin-worker-park-resume
workload: Cold start of a parked tools-only plugin: interpreter + import of wizolt.plugins.worker, and PluginProcess.start (boot + load handshake + capabilities) with a minimal one-tool plugin, 5 sequential runs; a warm invoke on the same worker timed for contrast.
comparison: Before: every enabled plugin paid full_start at each agent start and stayed resident. After (e53b90f4): tools-only plugins pay it once per enable/reload plus once per first call after a park; discovery and warm calls are unchanged.
